title: Injecting (prepend/append) results/hits
body:
I am trying to prepend a "featured" item to my results.

I am able to do this with the hits widget's transformData option, except it seems this is done to late (only for the template), so pagination, totals, etc. are then all off.

Where/when can I inject a result into my search so that counts and pagination aren't thrown off?
Furthermore, using transformData causes it to be added on every paginated render, I only want it on the first.
